Local copies of the site's front-end libraries so the course works offline.
Sources (cdn.jsdelivr.net): docsify 4.13.1 (core, vue theme, search),
docsify-plugin-flexible-alerts 1.1.1, mermaid 10.9.1, docsify-mermaid 2.0.1.
Google Fonts (Roboto Mono, Source Sans Pro) are in fonts/, vue.css @imports fonts/fonts.css instead of googleapis.
